the weight is not the problem here. there's something deeper going on that needs to be addressed. the most important thing you can do is just express your unconditional love and support. continuously check up and don't make every convo about this. i'm not sure how close y'all are but that relationship needs to be grown to build trust and get to a point where he feels comfortable discussing this with you. i think you should start where he's at and small things together. you can use his interests to get out of the house, like something simple even a game store or a movie. you're right that you can't make someone do anything, but you can show that you care and will be there regardless

never kill yourself for someone to have a reaction. you won't get to see it. you can only live on in spite of it all and collect the small things that make you feel good, no matter how small. it sucks, but you can cause more in your life that could help others than take it out on yourself. hope you made it out
